name: gdd
description: Turn a game idea into a Game Design Document through a pillar-first concept interview, a deep interview forked for video games or tabletop games, optional web research, an audited draft, parallel supplement generation, and a session index, pausing at user checkpoints.

interface.shortDescription: Generate Game Design Documents with a guided agent pipeline
interface.longDescription: Start from a one-line game idea and end with an audited Game Design Document plus supplementary documents (stats tables, item lists, lore bible, character sheets, rules references, diagrams) and a navigable INDEX.md. The pipeline establishes design pillars and constraints in a concept interview, then forks into a comprehensive video-game or tabletop interview with selectable depth, recording every answer, assumption, and open question in a ledger. It optionally runs historical, market, and technical web research in parallel, vets the findings, writes the GDD from a family-specific template, audits it for traceability and completeness, recommends supplements, and generates the selected ones in parallel. Every session is resumable from state.json.
defaultPrompt: Create a Game Design Document for my game idea.
Show the status of my GDD project.
